Meet Tracy

The only hands in your hair

Tracy Wright

Something Special is a sole-proprietor salon. There is no rotating cast and no handing you off: Tracy takes every appointment herself, one client at a time.

Her training stems from Vidal Sassoon in New York City, and listings credit her with 40 years of giving clients hair services. That shows up in the chair as a stylist who listens first and cuts second.

The shop is more than a salon, too. Alongside hair and nails there is a jewelry and gift store in the same space, so an appointment doubles as a browse.
